name: 2-10x Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 2 to 10 times its normal price in tech points: you choose the multiplier with the 2-10x Tech Cost slider in the patcher window (a whole number, 3 unless you move it). The normal prices are: Farming level 2 6,000, level 3 50,000; Fertility level 2 11,000, level 3 240,000; Science level 2 12,000, level 3 150,000; Medicine level 2 15,000, level 3 250,000; Construction level 2 2,500, level 3 80,000; Spirituality level 2 5,000, level 3 80,000. At x 3, for example, a 5,000-point level costs 15,000. The Tech screen shows the multiplied price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. The higher you set it, the harder the game. **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: Every technology price immediate in the Tech screen's hover label (0x434070), information box (0x4345E0) and buy handler (0x435AEF), each a price immediate, x N (the slider, 2 to 10; 3 by default): the shown price, the buy handler's refusal threshold (cmp / jb: too few tech points shows the game's message and spends nothing) and the amount it takes (sub) are the same multiplied number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
